about: The person's order of agents a hand-over goes to (MIXAGENT1c; D163's MIXAGENT1b-iii note; D191's settling of the design): the present doors of tools other than the session's own, one door per tool by its first present door, in the roster's order. A door's tool is its `accountOf` owner, else itself. The table both read: the page's `otherToolDoors` (`work/start/handOverOffer.ts`, through `handOverOrder.test.ts`) and the driver's `HandOverOrder.Others` (`HandOverOrderTests`). Each row: its name, the session's adapter, the roster's doors as [harness, present, accountOf], and the harnesses in order.
rows: another tool after the session's own
the session's own tool through another door is not another tool
a tool with two doors is one candidate, by its first present door
a door not present is passed over
an adapter the roster does not hold is its own tool
a blank accountOf is no owner
no other tool is no order
